CW Front Steering Fin - Qty: 1540 Nos. ____________________________________________________________________________________ 1. Technical Terms: a) The item is procured against requirement of Project 752MRSAM (IN & IAF). b) The item should be supplied as per QAP Doc No. MSQAA/HYD/MRSAM/FRONT FIN/01, Issue 01, R ev.00, Dated Oct 2024. c) Inspection reports, Test reports (QT/AT) and Test Specimens (if any) and MSQAA Quality Assura nce Certificate (QAC)/I-Notes etc. to be submitted with supplies as per given QAP. d) Inspection Authority/Agency: Principal Director, MSQAA Hyderabad or their authorized representative.

e) BDL/MSQAA reserves the right to audit the vendor premis and the premises of their subcontract ors. f) All the Required Tools, Jigs, Fixtures, Equipment, Test setups, Gauges etc. to be used in manufac turing, testing and inspection of items are in vendor's scope only, which are to be certified by proj ect RCI/BDL. Certified drawings to be submitted to BDL. g) Vendor has to submit the following documents. i) Process plan ii) Inspection plan iii) QA Matrix h) Applicable Drawings & BOM are as per QAP. i) Each missile requires 2 No's of CW & 2 No's of CCW Front steering Fin Assembly. Front fin Assem bly components are mentioned as per BoM in QAP. j) List of Deliverables: a) Each CW Front steering fin/CW Front fin consist of CW Front fin Assembly - 1 No. It should be supplied as per B.O.M of QAP Document No. MSQAA/HY D/MRSAM/FRONT FIN/01, Issue 01, Rev.00, Dated Oct 2024. b) Each CCW Front steering fin/ CCW Front fin consists of CCW Front fin Assembly - 1 No. It should be supplied as per B.O.M of QAP Document No.MSQAA/HYD/MRSAM/FRONT FIN/01, Issue 01, Rev.0 0, Dated Oct 2024. k) All the documents and drawings are supplied are the property of RCI/BDL. These documents and drawings shall not be used for any other purpose. The vendor is strictly prohibited from furthe r utilizing or passing of any of the design details or the details of the drawings whole or part. l) All the Raw Materials required for manufacturing shall be procured from approved source as per QAP. m) All bought out items/Standard items to be procured from the approved sources as per QAP. n) The items should be as per latest drawings, revisions / amendments if any. o) Split Ratio is applicable as 60:40 (for L1 60% and L2 40%).

2. Commercial terms: a) Qty. ordered are qualified (usable) deliverable units. b) Price is inclusive of free delivery at BDL stores (Kanchanbagh) Hyderabad. Packing & forwarding , freight, transit insurance etc. are under vendor scope. c) Packing & Forwarding: Items should be securely packed as per standard specification / guidelin es/ for severe road / rail / air / sea transport conditions and the packing charges borne by the supplier. d) The empty packing boxes may be collected by vendor once the items are used by BDL, in " as is where is " condition. BDL issues the empty boxes on its availability and at their discretion. e) Freight, Transit Insurance etc., is in supplier scope and at their cost. f) Taxes: GST will be extra as applicable at the time of supply. In case of delay beyond delivery sc hedules of PO then any increase in levies at the time of supply will not be considered and only the earlier percentage of levy will be paid. No custom duty exemption certificate will be issued by BD L. g) Delivery Schedule: Delivery shall commence from T0+12 months @ 30 set's each per month till the order completion. - Where T0 is date of issue of MSQAA vetted Purchase Order. Early deliveries are also accepted. Note: - Per Set: 2 CW ea & Per Set 2 CCW ea Fins. h) Payment terms: 90% of basic value and 100% taxes shall be paid within 30 days against receip t of material along with nominated inspection agency I-note and acceptance at BDL. The balance 1 0% of basic value shall be paid on submission of PBG for the value 5% of the supplied items value with 33 months (including claim period) by way of online payment/ Demand draft / Bankers Chequ e / Bank Guarantee from scheduled bank. i) Payment will be on pro-rata basis for accepted items. j) BDL reserves its right to release GST only after suppliers invoice / debit note is reflected in GSTR -2B/2A within the specified time limit mentioned in GST Law.

k) Security deposit: security deposit shall be submitted by the successful bidders for 5% of the ord er value (by way of Online payment / Demand Draft / Bankers Cheque / bank guarantee from sche duled banks) within one week from the date of purchase order and valid up to successful executio n of the order till the last delivery date as per purchase order plus 3 months claim period. NSIC cer tificate in lieu of Security Deposit is not acceptable. l) Warranty: The items supplied must bear warranty for 30 months from the date of acceptance at BDL. Warranty certificate should accompany with supplies. m) Performance Bank Guarantee (PBG): Supplier shall furnish a PBG for 5% of order value by way of online payment / Demand draft / Bankers Cheque / Bank Guarantee from scheduled bank valid till end of warranty period plus 3 months claim period. n) LD Clause: Time is the essence of the P.O and delivery should be strictly insisted upon according to the delivery schedule given in the SOs/POs. In the event the supplier fails to deliver th e goods / service, within the stipulated delivery period, BDL reserves the right to recover from the supplier, LD and not by way of penalty an amount as detailed in terms and conditions. A sum of 0. 5% of the price only of the stores (Including duties, taxes) which the supplier has failed to deliver as aforesaid for each week of delay or part thereof, subject to a maximum of 10%. In case of extension of delivery period, increase in taxes shall not be borne by BDL, if delay is attri butable to vendor. o) Product support: Post Warranty Service is to be provided for the items supplied for 20 years. p) GST applicable rate shall be levied extra on the liquidated damages recovered. q) Option Clause: - BDL retains the right to place order for additional quantity up to a maximum of 100%of the originally PO/contract quantity at the same rate & terms of PO/contract during executi on or within one year from the date of last supply of the PO/contract. r) Non-Disclosure Agreement: Vendor has to submit Non-Disclosure Agreement as per the format provided by BDL. s) Integrity Pact: Vendor has to submit Integrity Pact Agreement as per the format provided by BD L. t) FIM (Free Issue Material): No FIMS will be issued by BDL. u) The Prices indicated in the PO (After finalizing the bids and release of PO) are firm and fixed i.e., no subject alteration / variation on any account unless specified in the purchase order.

v) Place of Inspection: At vendor place or any of their units or Work Centers or their sub-contractor s location. 3. Other terms & conditions: a) No Custom Duty Exemption Certificate, No Excise Duty Exemption Certificate and No FIM will b e issued by BDL. b) Fall Clause: The Price charged for items supplied under the purchase order/contract shall be in No event exceed the lowest price at which the vendor sells the stores or offers to sell the items of I dentical description to any persons/organizations including the purchase of any department of the central Govt. or any dept. of the state govt. or any statutory undertaking of the central or state go vt. As the case may be during the period till the performance of the supply order placed and durin g currency of the purchase order/contract is completed. If at any time during the said period, the c ontractor reduces the sales price, sells or offers to sell such items to any person/organization inclu ding the purchaser or any department of central govt. or any dept. of state govt. or any statutory u ndertaking of the central or state govt. as the case may be at a price lower than the price chargea ble under the contract, He shall forthwith notify such reduction/sale or offer to sale to the BDL and the price payable under the contract for the items supplied after the date of coming into force of s uch reduction or sale or offer to sale shall stand correspondingly reduced. c) Risk purchase clause: In the event the supplier fails to fulfill the purchase order obligations, BDL reserves the right: i) To purchase elsewhere without notice to the supplier, on account and at the risk of the supplier, the stores not delivered or other of similar description (which in the opinion of BDL shall be readily procurable) without cancelling the purchase order in respect of consignment not yet due for delive ry.(or) ii) To cancel the purchase order in the event action being taken as above the supplier shall be liabl e for any loss which BDL may sustain on that account by the supplier shall not be entitled to any g ain on repurchase made against default. d) On release of PO, the vendor should submit the order acceptance within seven days. In case of Non receipt of order acceptance by BDL within a week from the date of PO, it is deemed that the P O is accepted in Total without any exceptions. e) Specify the material HSN code. Responsibility of correct classification of GST TAX code lies with vendor. f) The vendor shall provide the list of their subcontractors and activities outsourced by them and B DL reserves the right to audit the vendor premises and the premises of their subcontractors. g) Vendor shall mention the details of items to be imported which are required for manufacturing o

f assembly. This is needed to know the import content. h) All other general terms and conditions as per BDL limited tender terms and conditions. i) Vendor shall register in IDM (India Defence Mart) portal and NCAGE & NCAGE+ details shall be f urnished to BDL. j) It may be noted that wherever special conditions are listed above, the same will be supersedes t he conditions mentioned in general terms and conditions of the tender enquiry / Purchase order (P O). k) Consignee address: Incharge Store - LR / MRSAM Bharat Dynamics Limited, Kanchanbagh, Hyderabad - 500058, Telangana. Phone No: - 040-2458 7770. IMM No: 040-2458 7572. Note: - The Material to be supplied along with e-way bill, duplicate copy for transporter (GST Invoic e), Packing list and I-note/Inspection clearance/COC/Warranty (whichever is applicable). . 6.
